rootCause.summary: Job C scanned all sealed raw evidence bytes for historical case-ID substrings without field-aware provenance. Two historical case-ID strings also appear as visible label text in the current truth-free source images. OCR extracted those strings, and they propagated deterministically into word, line, candidate, ranking and selection records. No hit was a forbidden evidence key or historical fixture path, and no hit first appeared in provenance, configuration, source path metadata or another hidden external-identity field.
rootCause.failedVerifierBehavior: unrestricted substring matching over every raw JSON byte
rootCause.repairedVerifierContract: historical fixture paths and forbidden evidence keys remain fail-closed anywhere; historical case-ID strings halt in provenance, configuration, malformed JSON, binary or other external fields, but OCR-derived text and its structured candidate/selection propagation do not halt when the containing record carries local OCR text provenance
